name: Caught One!
description: Catch your first imp.
badge: A jingle-bell net with one small imp tail poking out

name: Slippery Little Thing
description: An imp escapes your trap for the first time.
badge: Tiny clawed footprints running off the edge of the badge through snow

name: Elf Emporium Regular
description: Buy your first item in the Elf Emporium.
badge: A red-and-white striped shopping bag with an elf hat on top

name: New Trap Smell
description: Equip a trap other than the starter Starlit Stocking.
badge: A trap with a gift tag and a little sparkle

name: Workshop Apprentice
description: Craft your first item in Santa's Workshop.
badge: A small mallet resting on a half-wrapped present

name: Deeper into the Lair
description: Unlock and travel to a second location.
badge: A lantern-lit arched door in an ice wall, slightly open

name: Warming Up
description: Hunt 100 times.
badge: A mitten with "100" stitched on it

name: Night Shift
description: Hunt 500 times.
badge: A crescent moon over a frosted workshop window

name: Tireless Hunter
description: Hunt 1,500 times.
badge: A steaming cocoa mug with a tally of marks on the side

name: Never Sleeps
description: Hunt 5,000 times.
badge: An alarm clock buried in snow, ringing, with a nightcap hung on it

name: Pocketful of Imps
description: Catch 50 imps.
badge: A coat pocket bulging, three imp tails sticking out

name: Sackful of Imps
description: Catch 250 imps.
badge: A drawstring sack wriggling with imps

name: Sleighload of Imps
description: Catch 1,000 imps.
badge: A small sleigh piled high with a tied-down, wriggling sack

name: On a Roll
description: Catch 10 imps in a row (quiet hunts don't break the run, escapes do).
badge: A snowball rolling downhill, growing, with "10" on it

name: Unstoppable
description: Catch 25 imps in a row.
badge: A huge snowball flattening a fence, "25" on it

name: Pocket Money
description: Earn 1,000 gold from catches.
badge: Three gold coins with holly on them

name: Stocking Stuffed
description: Earn 25,000 gold from catches.
badge: A stocking overflowing with gold coins

name: Santa's Treasurer
description: Earn 250,000 gold from catches.
badge: A brass-bound treasure chest with a candy-cane lock

name: Deputised
description: Reach Elf Deputy (rank 2).
badge: The rank 2 badge art on a red ribbon

name: On the Trail
description: Reach Imp Tracker (rank 3).
badge: The rank 3 badge art on a green ribbon

name: Keeper of the Cold
description: Reach Frost Warden (rank 4).
badge: The rank 4 badge art on an icy blue ribbon

name: Marshal of Yule
description: Reach Yule Marshal (rank 5, end of v1).
badge: The rank 5 badge art on a gold ribbon with a star

name: A Bit Unusual
description: Catch your first uncommon imp.
badge: A magnifying glass over a single odd-coloured footprint

name: Rare Find
description: Catch your first rare imp.
badge: A glass bauble with a tiny imp trapped inside

name: Rare Collector
description: Catch every rare imp in v1.
badge: A shelf of four baubles, each with an imp inside

name: Pantry Swept Clean
description: Catch every Cookie Pantry imp at least once.
badge: A cookie jar with a lid and a tick mark

name: All Wrapped Up
description: Catch every Wrapping Room imp at least once.
badge: A tied ribbon bow with a tick mark in the knot

name: Every Last Cog
description: Catch every Toy Workshop imp at least once.
badge: A brass cog with a tick mark cut out of its centre

name: Stable Hand
description: Catch every Reindeer Stables imp at least once.
badge: A horseshoe hung over a stable door, with a tick

name: Checked Every Name
description: Catch every imp in v1 at least once (a full Naughty List).
badge: A long scroll unrolled, every line ticked, a wax seal at the bottom

name: Big Trouble
description: Catch your first mini boss.
badge: A cracked cage with one big horn showing

name: Boss Hunter
description: Catch your first local boss.
badge: A small crown with horns, lying in a trap

name: Unwrapped
description: Catch Madame Shredwell.
badge: A pair of shears snapped in half over torn wrapping paper

name: Clocked Out
description: Catch Foreman Grimbolt.
badge: A workshop time-card stamped "OUT"

name: Grounded
description: Catch Grizzlewick the Horned.
badge: A curled horn tied down with sleigh-bell harness

name: Bigger They Come
description: Catch 10 mini bosses or bosses in total.
badge: A stack of three tiny horned crowns

name: Tick-Tock Trapper
description: Catch 25 imps with a Clockwork trap.
badge: A brass gear with a key in its side

name: Wish Upon a Trap
description: Catch 25 imps with a Starlight trap.
badge: A five-pointed star with a soft glow and a tiny net

name: Cold Snap
description: Catch 25 imps with a Frost trap.
badge: A snowflake with an icicle hanging from each point

name: Three of a Kind
description: Own a trap of every power type at once.
badge: The three power-type symbols in a triangle

name: Know Thy Imp
description: Catch 100 imps with a trap type they are weak to.
badge: An open field guide with a pointing finger on one entry

name: Ring the Bells
description: Craft the Sleigh-Bell Snapper.
badge: Two crossed sleigh bells with a brass jaw beneath

name: Sweet Tooth
description: Wrapping Room: craft your first Ribbon Candy.
badge: A twisted ribbon candy on a stick

name: Top of the Ladder
description: Wrapping Room: attract Madame Shredwell with a Golden Bow Bonbon.
badge: A little ladder with a bonbon on the top rung

name: Order Up
description: Toy Workshop: finish your first order.
badge: A paper toy order pinned to a cork board, all boxes ticked

name: Workshop Favourite
description: Toy Workshop: finish 10 orders.
badge: A full cork board with ten pinned orders

name: Rush Job
description: Toy Workshop: finish a Rush order.
badge: A toy order with a red "RUSH" stamp and speed lines

name: Liftoff!
description: Reindeer Stables: launch the sleigh.
badge: A sleigh lifting off a snowy runway with a trail of sparkles

name: Express Delivery
description: Reindeer Stables: launch the sleigh with 10 or more hunts left on the countdown.
badge: A sleigh with motion streaks and a stopwatch

name: Butterfingers
description: 5 escapes in a row.
badge: A slippery bar of soap with an imp riding on it

name: Silent Night
description: 4 hunts in a row with no imp attracted.
badge: A sleeping trap with a nightcap and "zzz"

name: Robbed Blind
description: Be pillaged by an escaping imp for the first time.
badge: An empty sack turned inside out, one coin falling

name: Lucky Stocking
description: Catch a mini boss or boss with the starter Starlit Stocking.
badge: A worn old stocking with a big horn sticking out of it

name: Top of the List
description: Be first on the Hunters leaderboard by points after a hunt.
badge: A podium with a candy-cane "1"

name: Grounded Again
description: Reindeer Stables: let the countdown run out on a sleigh run.
badge: A sleigh nose-down in a snowdrift
